title: Cost-Share Protection and State Billing Cycles by Special Needs Plans Package
content:
Whether members of a Special Needs Plans package in a qualifying Medicaid category owe no plan cost share, whether the package permits the cost share they are protected from to be billed to the state Medicaid agency, how often those billings are raised, and how long the state has to pay one, are all fixed by the package.

| Plan benefit package | Members in a qualifying Medicaid category owe no plan cost share | The plan may bill the state for cost share the member is protected from | Calendar days between billings to the state | Calendar days the state has to pay a billed cost share |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | yes | yes | 30 | 45 |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | yes | yes | 30 | 45 |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | no | no | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | no | no | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | no | no | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | yes | yes | 30 | 45 |

## Basis of each column

The first column records whether members of the package in a qualifying Medicaid category owe no plan cost share. The second records whether the plan may bill the state for cost share the member is protected from. The third is the calendar days between the plan's cost-share billings to the state, and the fourth the calendar days the state has to pay a billed cost share.

## Condition and result

> Where the package carries cost-share protection, a member of that package who is in a qualifying Medicaid category owes no plan cost share; where the package also permits it, the cost share so protected is billed to the state Medicaid agency every 30 calendar days, and the state has 45 calendar days to pay each billing.

The three packages carrying protection are Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP), Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) and Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP), and each of those three also permits billing the state. The three chronic condition packages carry neither, and carry 0 calendar days in both cycle columns.
